create.name: Zen Center of Spokane
create.bio:
The Zen Center of Spokane is a lay Zen group in downtown Spokane, Washington, affiliated with the Diamond Sangha, the lineage founded by Robert Aitken Rōshi that joins the Sōtō and Rinzai approaches. Its teacher is Jack Duffy Rōshi, one of Aitken's dharma heirs, who makes his home on Lummi Island, among the San Juans, and guides the group mostly at a distance; Carlos Abusaid Elias, his apprentice teacher, has also given talks at its retreats. Being a Buddhist is not required to sit with the group, and people from any tradition are welcome.

The zendo is a room in the Saranac Building on West Main Avenue, entered by keypad, so first-time visitors arrange a short orientation by phone or through the website's form and come a little early. Members sit together three times a week, in rounds of twenty-five minutes broken by walking meditation and a short sutra recitation. On the first Saturday of most months Duffy joins by Zoom to give a talk, answer questions and meet students one to one. Twice a year, in spring and late autumn, the group holds a five-day retreat that people can attend in the zendo or online, and recordings of the teacher's talks from these retreats and the Saturday sessions are posted on its website.

courses.title: Weekly zazen and monthly teisho
courses.description: Group sitting three times a week in the downtown zendo, in rounds of twenty-five minutes with walking meditation and a short sutra recital. On the first Saturday of most months the teacher, Jack Duffy Rōshi, joins by Zoom for a talk, questions and private interviews. New people arrange an orientation before their first sit.

courses.title: Semi-annual hybrid retreats
courses.description: Five-day Zen retreats held each spring and late autumn, led by Jack Duffy Rōshi, which can be attended in the Spokane zendo or remotely on Zoom. Days are given to zazen, walking meditation and the teacher's talks.

free_resources.title: Dharma talks (teisho)
free_resources.description: Recordings of Jack Duffy Rōshi's talks from the group's retreats since 2023 and from the monthly Saturday sessions, with a few given by Carlos Abusaid Elias.

free_resources.title: For newcomers
free_resources.description: A short guide for first-time visitors on sitting and walking meditation as the group practises them, with links to two beginners' talks by Jack Duffy and a suggested introductory book.
